huangyuchuh-comfyui-skills-openclaw-root.description: Run registered ComfyUI workflows through the fast comfyui-skill CLI, and use the official local Comfy MCP for live template, node, model, validation, and orchestration capabilities. **Use this Skill when:** (1) The user requests to "generate an image", "draw a picture", or "execute a ComfyUI workflow". (2) The user has specific stylistic, character, or scene requirements for image generation. (3) The user asks you to import, register, sync, or configure saved ComfyUI workflows for later reuse.
